# Selected campaign producer fixtures

`reports.json` contains recorded model envelopes for all 24 pinned curated sources.
The native outputs were generated by the qualified zetesis `2c05ea7` installed
binary (SHA-256 `9624262829fe06bd5a671b3b04c7e8b9cdc6361b13b720f29a9def18dec1ab1d`)
and independently compared with clingo on 2026-09-07. There are 73 full-model
occurrences. Native statistics and reference input paths/times were removed;
model identities and completion envelopes were preserved.

These fixtures test the validation harness, including deliberate corruptions.
They are not new solver, performance or hardware evidence. The live external
campaign separately runs the original byte-exact `.lp` files. Their immutable
provenance and MIT notices remain in `validation/upstream/clingo-5.8.2/curated`.
